scope: Ordinary native release, complete-process CPU/wall samples. Same-source MVP kernels only; no full typesetting, PGO retiming, or Wasm runtime claim.
line_count_method: Physical lines including comments/blanks; exclude separate Rust test modules. Allocation adapter counted separately. All six Python tools included.

validation.unchanged_generator_outputs: All 19 cases at sizes 1, 64, 1024 compared byte-for-byte, including expected results and workload metadata.

measurement_protocol: Pinned CPU, one warmup, checksum validated on every execution. Native runners rotate/reverse three engines for seven repetitions. Confirmations use 21 alternating before/after pairs, same-LTO control uses nine; retained samples include CPU and wall time. Builds, Miri, and allocation diagnostics excluded from timed runs.

kernels.name: spelling
kernels.adaptation: Definitions unchanged. Bootstrap ifcanspell with let instead of loading plain newif. The preceding aesthetic macro needs an accent and is omitted.

kernels.name: today
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Define plain's space macro and assign calendar parameters explicitly.

kernels.name: talks
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Consume expanded sentences in definitions rather than typesetting them.

kernels.name: contentsentry
kernels.adaptation: Retain the complete write payload in a parameterized macro invoked in edef. Stringified line/dotfill names and braces are never executed. Bootstrap pageno with countdef.

kernels.name: maketable
kernels.adaptation: Retain the bracketed-title and paragraph-delimited signature; replace the box/display body with edef of both complete payloads.

native_expansion.validation: Every record compares its expanded definition with independently generated expected tokens; comparison and expected definition construction are timed.
native_expansion.storage: Immutable definitions and token lists are reclaimed after their last semantic owner; bump chunks and value IDs are reused. Interned names remain session-owned.

memory.scope: Full-process CPU/wall medians; allocator requests cover engine construction/execution and exclude the compact host input. Heap peaks are requested bytes, not RSS. pdfTeX memory is not measured by this adapter.
